title: Asahina Mafuyu — Finding A Way To Repay〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I saw the lyrics earlier, so that sounds good.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Then, I'll show Enanan and Amia later...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I didn't realize you two were here.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's easy to forget once we start working, so I decided to log on fifteen minutes early.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, I know it isn't 25:00 yet, but I'll send the edited lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry! My sis just called me over.
I'll be right back!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That was confusing. I thought you were being told to wait, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <What do you think is going on?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm back! You gotta hear this!
She got me some fruit jelly♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's nice.
Jellies are perfect for a bit of guilt-free late-night snacking.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Exactly! But I'm starting to feel like I should give back to Sis, since she's given me so many snacks and souvenirs and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Shouldn't we also do the same?
We've also received quite a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We did get a lot of snacks.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, you guys don't have to do that.
I really don't think she minds.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But you're going to get her something, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's just something I want to do, though...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<And we want to as well.
I mean, she even gave us those scrunchies for New Year's.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... Snacks seem like the easiest choice...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But what do you plan on getting her, Amia?
Lend us a hand as our special advisor.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Having Amia join us should make things much easier.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, Mizuki, before we start shopping for your sister's gift...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can you tell us if there's anything she's been wanting lately?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, what makes you think I know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just kidding! I actually do know♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she just happened to tell me that she's been looking for a scarf.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you just happen to ask her just for today...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. No, it's not like that. Since she came back, we've been talking about going shopping together and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I asked her about any shops that she wants to check out, and she told me that she's hoping to go to ones where she might find a new scarf.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Then, for now, why don't we try looking for shops which carry nice scarves?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
How about this scarf?
The pattern's a bit bold, but the colors are really nice. She could pull it off, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... She probably could pull it off, but it's not really her style, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This one's very chic. Wouldn't it look good on her?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but have you seen the price tag?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's a brand-name item, so it's normal for it to come at a premium. I don't think we can afford it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, so I think it's time to check out my ace in the hole.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a shop that opened here just recently, and it's full of stuff that my sis would like. We even made plans to go check it out soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean we shouldn't go?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree...
If we go now, then we'd be taking away from your fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not a problem! Going with her is fun in one way, and us going as a group is fun in a different way♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, really! Let's see... I think it was this way!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, there it is! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, I've also been wondering about this shop.
It looks really hip and trendy. I really like it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'd never be able to go in there myself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I hope we find something good here.

No, thank you as well!
We really appreciate you deciding to visit our shop today.
